name: SEC EDGAR Filings
title: SEC EDGAR Filings Feed: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, Form 4, Form D, S-1
uses: Investors and analysts watching 8-Ks and insider Form 4s for a watchlist
AI research agents that need what a company filed this week as JSON
Deal, IR and compliance teams tracking Form D raises, S-1s and 13D stakes

inputs.name: tickers
inputs.title: Tickers
inputs.description: Optional stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","NVDA"]. Resolved to CIKs with the SEC ticker file.

inputs.name: ciks
inputs.title: CIK numbers
inputs.description: Optional SEC Central Index Keys, e.g. ["320193"]. Leave tickers and CIKs empty to get latest filings across all companies.

inputs.name: formTypes
inputs.title: Form types
inputs.description: Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K","10-K","10-Q","4","D","S-1","13F-HR","SC 13D"]. Empty = all forms (company mode only; market-wide mode needs at least one).

inputs.name: filedWithinDays
inputs.title: Filed within (days)
inputs.description: Only filings from the last N days. 0 = no limit (company mode returns the ~1000 most recent).

inputs.name: onlyNew
inputs.title: Only new since last run
inputs.description: true = skip filings delivered by an earlier run with the same tickers/CIKs/forms. Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.title: Max results
inputs.description: Maximum rows (1-5000). You pay per row, so this caps cost: 100 rows = $0.20.

inputs.name: contactEmail
inputs.title: Contact email for SEC User-Agent
inputs.description: Optional. SEC asks automated clients to identify themselves; this email is sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov only.

description: Monitor SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or CIK, including 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4 insider trades, Form D and S-1. Each result has the company, form type, filing date and document links. Only-new mode turns it into an alert feed for investors, research and AI agents.

inputSchema.title: SEC EDGAR Filings Feed: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, Form 4, Form D, S-1
inputSchema.description: Returns SEC EDGAR filings as one JSON row per filing, from official sec.gov / data.sec.gov endpoints. With tickers or CIKs it reads each company's filing history; with neither it returns the latest market-wide filings of the chosen form types. Example: {"tickers":["AAPL","TSLA"],"formTypes":["8-K","10-Q"],"filedWithinDays":30}. Pricing: $0.002 per filing row.
